blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Impeachment Court has shot down the recurring claim made by Vice President Sara Duterte’s legal team about the prosecution using evidence not part of the original complaints against her, saying that documents can be the subject of subpoenas. In its order dated November 5 and released to the media on Friday, the impeachment court has overruled the continuing objection made by Duterte’s lawyers regarding the prosecution’s formal offer of evidence — particularly allegations that the House of Representatives engaged in a “fishing expedition.” Since the House committee on justice discussed the raps against Duterte last March […]...
